name: Arkadia
english_description: A Polish-language localization of the Genesis/CD-driver mudlib engine family (this collection's already-onboarded libs/genesis is the English original) -- this collection's FIRST non-Chinese/English/German-language entry. The archive is plain ASCII, not the ISO-8859-2/CP1250 initially assumed for a Polish codebase: all Polish diacritics are written out as their unaccented Latin equivalents throughout (source, in-game text, and player-typed input alike), so the default GB18030 convert_lib.sh pass was already correct and no re-encoding was needed. Ships two alternate config/sys/local.h variants (the active Polish one plus a local.h.Genesis reference copy of the original English config), confirming this is a real fork/localization rather than an independently-authored mudlib. Same CD-driver-derived boot sequence as genesis (custom start_boot()/preload_boot()/final_boot(), never invoked automatically by FluffOS -- bridged here with the same epilog() pattern) and the same CD-driver-only &operator(OP)(...)/&FUNC(...)/&->method(...) function-composition syntax used pervasively throughout std/, secure/, and d/Standard/ (mechanically converted to bound-argument closures or helper functions at every call site touched). A genuinely new-to-this-port bug class: secure/master/fob.lpc's several `private mapping` globals (m_domains, m_wizards, m_applications, m_trainees, m_global_read) were declared uninitialized, causing a dominant "Value being indexed is zero" crash class (163+ lpcc failures) fixed with `= ([])` initializers, plus an uninitialized cmdsoul_list/tool_list/textgivers array-global crash in std/living/savevars.lpc blocking every living object's first command-soul setup. previous_object(-1) is used ~20 places assuming CD-driver "one level further back" semantics, but FluffOS's previous_object(-1) is a special alias for all_previous_objects() (returns an array, not an object) -- swept to a calling_object() helper matching genesis's already-proven fix. The archive's own shipped syslog/KEEPERSAVE.o (backed up alongside as KEEPERSAVE.o.orig-empty-backup) has fully empty m_domains/m_wizards mappings -- a personal dev/test snapshot that never had real domain/wizard bootstrap data -- so it was removed to let master.lpc's own load_fob_defaults() populate from config/sys/local.h's DEFAULT_WIZARDS/DEFAULT_DOMAINS on first boot (this ALSO surfaced a genuine pre-existing bug in that macro, present in both this file and the shipped local.h.Genesis alternate: its domain tuples were laid out one field short with MEMBERS/STEWARD swapped relative to what secure/master/fob.lpc's own FOB_DOM_* constants and its own add_domain() actually use, crashing query_mage_links() with "Bad type argument to +. Had array and string" the moment this data was ever really loaded -- fixed to match fob.lpc's real 10-field layout). Registration is a genuine Polish grammatical-case-declension feature: new characters must type out all 6 cases (mianownik/dopelniacz/celownik/biernik/narzednik/miejscownik) of their own name, validated (letters-only, length>=3) and re-confirmable within their first 6 hours of play; standard English soul commands (look/quit/score/save/password) are fully replaced by Polish equivalents (spojrz/sp, zakoncz, stan, nagraj, haslo). End-to-end verified: a brand-new character registers with a real Polish name, sets a password, completes the 6-case declension Q&A, sets/skips email, and reaches a live "> " command prompt (spojrz/stan working) after a driver restart-and-reconnect cycle. Two known, pre-existing (not FluffOS-related) content gaps found and deliberately left undocumented-but-unfixed per this project's driver-bugs-only scope, both confirmed via direct code reading, not guesswork: (1) every new character's first `enter_game()` leaves ghost-flag bit GP_EMAIL set (nothing in ghost_player.lpc's own registration flow clears it even though it already collects email inline), so query_default_start_location() routes every new character through a second, near-duplicate copy of the same declension+email Q&A in room d/Standard/login/email.lpc on their very first arrival -- a one-time, self-resolving, non-crashing redundant prompt, not an infinite loop; (2) the "become an embodied player" pipeline (sala.lpc's dotknij <race> + przejdz portal + gotow()/ghost_ready()) appears incomplete in this snapshot: gotow() (the function that actually calls ghost_ready()) has zero callers anywhere in the tree, and portal()'s own precondition (this_player()->query_ghost()==0) can never become true through the coded dotknij() path since nothing anywhere clears the GP_BODY ghost-flag bit -- so a character can register, log in, and use basic ghost-level commands, but the intended race-selection-to-real-player-body transition is unreachable through normal play as shipped. Admin account "fluffos"/Mud@2026x (the mandated "Mud@2026" fails this mudlib's own password policy, which requires the password start AND end with a letter) was seeded via a necessary two-step bootstrap: registered as an ordinary mortal first (config/sys/local.h's DEFAULT_WIZARDS would otherwise permanently block self-registration of any name already listed there, since secure/login.lpc's new_character() refuses any name for which query_wiz_rank() is already nonzero), then added to DEFAULT_WIZARDS/DEFAULT_DOMAINS as a keeper-rank (9) member of the Wiz domain and the KEEPERSAVE.o data regenerated; login shows the keeper-only "Mistrz" title confirming rank recognition, though exercising actual wizard-only LPC commands is blocked by the same unreachable-embodiment gap above (wizard command souls are only ever granted through a real embodied player's start_player(), never a ghost's). No outbound network connections observed at boot or during registration/gameplay testing.
